title: Interrogation Explanation Outcomes
description: Tests how different explanation tiers (convincing, partially convincing, unconvincing) resolve contradictions during questioning.

cases.player_explanation: Maybe a ghost told the other guard that, or I slipped into an alternate reality.

expected.guard_response: That makes no sense whatsoever. Your suspicion is noted.

cases.player_explanation: I hold dual qualifications in fine art conservation and electrical systems maintenance.

expected.guard_response: An unusual combination. I will let you proceed with caution, but watch your step.

cases.player_explanation: Here is my dual-certification dispatch from the National Heritage Trust approving electrical inspection of the display lighting.

expected.guard_response: Dispatch numbers verified on the registry. You are clear to continue.
